Implementation Plan

I've checked everything the report entry depends on, so here is the plan.

## Planning ref
- `git rev-parse HEAD`: `9bd4069c6ec5b71e050d5d3c105cdc1fc5e5eceb`, branch `orchestrator/project-8598` (integration branch; `Integration branch mismatch: false`).
- Orchestrator child issue of tracking issue #8598 (Local ID `record-report-delete-source`). The PR body links to it with `Refs #8598` only.

## Automation / wiring (§20.E)
- **Scripts:** this change adds no script and does not extend one. It deletes one analysis doc and adds one report entry. No code changes.
- **Scheduler entry point:** none is added. The existing `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` already treats a doc as processed when its file name appears in `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (line 341, `grep -qF -- "${candidate_basename}"`). The new heading and `Source doc:` line meet that check once the doc is deleted.
- **Supervisor:** none needed.
- **Database work:** none.
- **Removal registry (`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`):** no entry, because there is no new script.

## Files likely to change
- `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-28-2.md` (delete)
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (append one entry at end of file)

## Functions or modules to implement
No code. Two edits to files:

1. **Delete** `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-28-2.md`.
   - A tree-wide grep finds no other file that references this doc name, so deleting it breaks no test or link.

2. **Append** one entry after the last line of `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`.
   - The file ends with the `### \`analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-28.md\`` entry, which starts at line 1673 and ends at line 1691.
   - Leave one blank line, then add the entry. Do not touch line 5 `## Processed source docs (128)` or its list; the previous entries (09-26-3, 09-28) did not update it either.
   - Header, using the same shape as the 09-28 entry:
     ```
     ### `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-28-2.md`
     Source doc: `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-28-2.md`
     Processed: <UTC date the PR is written, YYYY-MM-DD; 2026-11-01 at planning time>
     Source commit: `86e24a3370e41ee62abc619595a0425cdd269423`
     ```
   - Then one bullet per recommendation, in the style `- <IDs> (<short topic>): <verdict> — <evidence>`. Each verdict must be `applied`, `already-implemented` or `rejected`. Each bullet below was re-verified on this ref:
     - **Exec 1 / Speed 1 / Cost 1 / Reliability 1 / per-repo action 1** (CI poll-shard heartbeat, per-test timing, remaining-budget warning, keep the timeout): already-implemented.
       - CI is split into parallel jobs with `timeout-minutes: 20` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
       - The orchestrate-poll single-file group emits `CI_SUBTEST_START` / `CI_SUBTEST_HEARTBEAT` / `CI_SUBTEST_END`.
       - The step `Check workflow sizes and CI job durations against their budgets` flags jobs near their timeout.
       - The 45-minute single job the doc measured no longer exists.
     - **Speed 2** (per-test timing for `Promote cycle and blocked-verdict unit tests`, controllable test clocks): rejected.
       - Measurement-only, with conditional savings and no slow test identified.
       - The step already runs in its own 20-minute job, `tests-promote-stall-and-review`.
     - **Speed 3 / Pipeline flow / Orchestrator health** (queue, setup, model and retry spans; skip reasons; correlation IDs; wait ages; ledger push-retry cause): rejected.
       - Measurement-only with no consumer.
       - The per-tick `state-snapshot` artifact (`scripts/build_state_snapshot.py`) and `POLL_PROGRESS` already cover counts per state.
       - The `claude_fixer_awaiting_session` items are obsolete because the Claude-fixer hand-off is retired.
     - **Exec 3 / Reliability 2 / Validate pipeline row / per-repo action 2**: applied by the validate pre-setup reporting PR (`changelog.d/wfopt-2026-09-28-2-validate-presetup.md`).
       - `Run validation process` and the record, force-tick, collect and upload steps now require authorization, runtime and support staging to have succeeded.
       - Authorization stays fail-closed.
     - **Exec 4 / Cost 2 / Prompt cache section**: already-implemented for per-call usage; the rest is rejected.
       - `scripts/cost_audit.py` aggregates `or_calls`, `or_cache_read_tokens` / `or_cache_write_tokens` and `or_usage_unavailable_calls`.
       - Prefix/version identifiers and `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN` ratios are rejected (no consumer).
       - Model step-down is rejected because the doc defers it.
     - **Cost 3** (Semble/Serena query telemetry) and the **Cost paragraph** on release-redispatch parent/dispatched-run IDs: rejected as measurement-only.
     - **Exec 5 / Reliability 3** (Semble contract-test fallback classification): already-implemented. Events carry `context=contract-test` (`scripts/cost_audit.py`, `tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py`), and fail-open behaviour is unchanged.
     - **AI Memory Health**: already-implemented. `AI_MEMORY_TELEMETRY` carries `op`, `ok`, `records_selected`, `estimated_tokens`, `keyword_method`, `fail_open` and `did_push`.
     - **GH API audit** (validation PR-list page telemetry, poller per-PR mergeability N-read logging, batch hit/miss logging): rejected.
       - Measurement-only, and the doc did not observe N.
       - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` is a hot file.
       - The authorization binding must not be cached.
     - **BUG-001**: already-implemented by the `active_snapshot_incomplete` gate in `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml`.
     - **BUG-002**: applied by the merge-train rename-path PR (issue #8599, `changelog.d/8599-merge-train-rename-previous-filename.md`).
       - The `pulls/<n>/files` query in `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` now also reads `previous_filename` when it is a non-empty string.
     - **SEC-001**: already-implemented. `_gh_cmd_log_summary` in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` (issue #8095) never prints flag values such as `-f body=`.
     - **BUG-003 and BUG-006**: applied by the Telegram cleanup PR (issue #8600, `changelog.d/8600-tg-cleanup-snapshot-retain.md`).
       - Cleanup reads every page of comments before deleting any.
       - A failed Telegram delete keeps its tracking comment so the delete can be retried.
     - **BUG-004 and BATCH-003**: rejected as obsolete. `scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh`, `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py`, `scripts/claude_issue_queue_watchdog.sh` and `scripts/claude_issue_route.py` no longer exist.
     - **BUG-005**: already-implemented.
       - `_mt_inflight_review_branches` in `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` lists every active status with created-bound follow-up queries.
       - When that listing is incomplete, release leaves PRs queued (`MERGE_TRAIN_RELEASE_RUNS_INCOMPLETE ... action=leave_queued`).
     - **API-001, BATCH-001, MERGE-001, REUSE-001**: rejected; the doc tags them RISKY_SKIP.
     - **API-002, BATCH-002**: rejected; the doc tags them NEEDS_VERIFICATION and they were not verified.
     - **DUP-001, DUP-002, DUP-003**: rejected; refactor-only, across trusted support-staging boundaries.
     - **EXPR-001**: already-implemented. In the `Stage workflow support files` step of `.github/workflows/implement.yml`, values are passed through `env:` and the `run:` body contains no `${{`.
     - **CONSIST-001**: rejected.
       - Routing the tracking-comment POST through `curl_gh_api` would retry a non-idempotent create on non-2xx responses and create duplicate tracking comments.
       - `scripts/tg_helpers.sh` must keep working with its plain-curl fallback when `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` is absent.
     - **DEAD-001 and SHELL-001**: rejected, consistent with earlier verdicts: naming immutability, and a style-level change in the hot poller file.
     - **DEBT-001**: rejected.
       - Raising ShellCheck to warning severity is a repo-wide lint policy change that needs every warning triaged first.
       - Current invocation: `ci.yml` runs `"${sc}" --severity=error "$f"` with ShellCheck pinned through `shellcheck-py==0.10.0.1`, falling back to the system `shellcheck` with a warning.

## Data structures affected
- Markdown only.
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` is read by `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` with a fixed-string match on the file name. The appended heading must contain the literal file name `workflow-optimization-2026-09-28-2.md`.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Keep `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py` unchanged
- **Chosen:** do not edit the test file; only run it.
- **Alternatives considered:** add a test that checks the real report lists the deleted doc.
- **Why:** every test in that file builds its own repo and report in a temp directory (`_run` writes `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` from a fixture at line 108). None reads the real report or the source doc, so nothing breaks. A new test would pin report content that changes with every analysis project. Hold Scope.

### D2 — Append only, below the last entry
- **Chosen:** add the entry after line 1691 and leave the `## Processed source docs (128)` count and list alone.
- **Alternatives considered:** also add the doc to the list at the top of the file and change the count to 129.
- **Why:** the issue says append only, without renumbering or reflowing. The 09-26-3 and 09-28 entries set the same precedent.

### D3 — How to cite the applied items
- **Chosen:**
  - Cite each applied item by its issue number and changelog fragment path: #8599 for BUG-002; #8600 for BUG-003/006; `changelog.d/wfopt-2026-09-28-2-validate-presetup.md` for the validate item.
  - Add a PR number only when it can be confirmed in the implement checkout, for example from a `(#NNNN)` suffix in a squash-merge commit subject on `orchestrator/project-8598`.
- **Alternatives considered:**
  - Cite only the earlier memory note that links issue 8600 to PR #8605.
